import rsa
import os
from Crypto.Random import get_random_bytes
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from base64 import b64encode, b64decode

def task_func():
    public_key, private_key = rsa.newkeys(512)

    filename = f"private_key_{get_random_bytes(8).hex()}.txt"
    password = get_random_bytes(16)
    nonce = get_random_bytes(16)

    private_key_bytes = private_key.save_pkcs1(format="PEM")
    block_size = AES.block_size
    pad_len = block_size - (len(private_key_bytes) % block_size)
    padded_private_key = private_key_bytes + bytes([pad_len]) * pad_len

    cipher = AES.new(password, AES.MODE_CBC, iv=nonce)
    encrypted_private_key = cipher.encrypt(padded_private_key)

    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b64encode(encrypted_private_key))

    return public_key, filename, password, nonce
